summary: AssessmentValidationResult is a sealed class representing validation outcomes for assessments, with specific boolean indicators for distinct rule checks.
purpose: To encapsulate and communicate the results of assessment validations, signalling whether particular validation rules have triggered.

workflows.name: Assessment Validation Workflow
steps: Set InterimWithoutFinal if interim assessment exists without final
Set InstructorsAndSupervisors if instructor/supervisor requirements not met
Set AssessmentMaximumExceeded if assessment exceeds maximum allowed

business_rules: InterimWithoutFinal: Interim assessments should not exist without a corresponding final
InstructorsAndSupervisors: Instructors and supervisors requirements must be met
AssessmentMaximumExceeded: Assessments must not exceed the maximum allowed
validations: Check for interim assessments without final
Confirm assessment does not exceed maximum allowed
system_behavior: Returns boolean flags for each validation rule after assessment checks
content_gaps: No information about how values are calculated
No details on interactions with other systems or entities
